description: Search for companies and business contacts in real time by industry, city, and other filters. Returns a ready-to-use list of leads (name, address, phone, website, rating, and email where available). Use this whenever the user asks to find, list, or collect businesses/companies for sales, outreach, or research.

city.description: City or region to search in, e.g. "Berlin" or "Austin, TX".

has_website.description: Only return businesses that have a website.

industry.description: Industry filter. One of the predefined categories.

lang.description: Result language as a BCP-47 tag, e.g. "en" or "pt-BR".

limit.description: Max number of results to return (1-20). Defaults to a server-side value if omitted.

list_id.description: Existing saved-list ID to append results to.

list_name.description: Name of a saved list to find-or-create and append results to.

min_rating.description: Minimum rating (0-5) a business must have to be included.

open_now.description: Only return businesses that are currently open.

page_token.description: Pagination token returned by a previous call, to fetch the next page of results.

q.description: Free-text search query, e.g. "construction companies in Munich". Optional if industry+city are given.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers around the city center.

save_to_list.description: If true, also save the results into a B2BLeads saved list (requires list_id or list_name).

verified_only.description: Only return businesses with a verified listing.

name: search_leads
